title: Quantity and address revisions
prompt:
Order initially 5 black keyboards to Mumbai. Update: 9 keyboards, same color. Final update: Pune replaces Mumbai. Extract quantity,color,city. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: quantity, color, city. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
